🔸Prominent Community Pandals: Shah is expected to tour prominent community celebrations, including Chetla Agrani and Sreebhumi Sporting Club, alongside several major barowari pujas across the metropolis.

note_tweet.text:
🪄THE NIGHT HOGWARTS CAME TO KOLKATA — AND A LAWSUIT THAT THREATENED THE MAGIC🪄

October 2007. Durga Puja was approaching, and Salt Lake’s FD Block had an extraordinary surprise in store: a Hogwarts-inspired pandal, bringing the magical world of Harry Potter to the streets of Kolkata.

Weeks of work transformed bamboo, canvas and papier-mâché into a spectacular castle. Inside, the fictional world of wizardry met the timeless devotion of Maa Durga. The pandal soon attracted huge crowds and media attention.

But then came an unexpected twist.

⚖️ A COPYRIGHT BATTLE.

Reports emerged that J.K. Rowling, Warner Bros. and rights holders had initiated legal proceedings over the unauthorised use of Harry Potter imagery. A reported ₹20 lakh damages demand put the organisers under pressure just as the festival was about to begin.

Could the pandal be forced to close?

On 12 October 2007, the Delhi High Court allowed the festivities to proceed during the Puja period. The reported damages were not imposed at that stage. It was not a blanket exemption from copyright law, but the gates of the Hogwarts-inspired pandal stayed open for the festival.

And so, for a few magical days, Hogwarts found a home in Kolkata.

A fictional British castle, a Bengali goddess, and a legal drama — only Durga Puja could bring them together. 🙏
